name: New Hope
source:
Everything isn't as it seems in Wellsprings, even secrets have a way of taking on a life of their own. Nothing stays hidden for long - and sooner or later what's done in the dark will be brought to light.

New Hope is a visual novel staring Justin, an 18 year old high school senior with two very big secrets. He is gay, and trying to hold onto his secret until finishing senior year and moving off to college. But when he loses his song book, things take an unexpected turn as Justin begins to message a mystery guy who shares the same secret.

As Justin, you have important choices to make that will shape your friendships and potential love interests. Will you keep your secret at all costs... or trust someone enough to confide in them in your darkest hour?

Being gay isn't Justin's only problem however...

[Edited from [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/new-hope]Itch.io[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/welcome-justin-47602992]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在泉源镇，一切都不像表面那样简单，就连秘密也仿佛有自己的生命。没有什么能永远隐藏，暗中做下的事，迟早会暴露在光天化日之下。

《New Hope》的主角贾斯汀是一名18岁的高中毕业班学生，藏着两个天大的秘密。他是同性恋，打算一直隐瞒到高中毕业、离家上大学。然而，当他弄丢自己的歌曲本后，事情却出现了意想不到的转折：贾斯汀开始与一位拥有相同秘密的神秘男子互发消息。

作为贾斯汀，你需要做出重要选择，决定友谊与潜在恋情的走向。你会不惜一切代价守住秘密，还是愿意信任某个人，在最黑暗的时刻向对方倾诉？

不过，同性恋身份并不是贾斯汀唯一的烦恼……
